name: Curator
description: Asks an LLM what your library has in common and builds the answers into ordered playlists surfaced as home screen rows.
overview: LLM-inferred vibe categories for your Jellyfin library.

versions.changelog: Feature-complete pipeline: library scan, LLM providers (Anthropic / OpenAI / OpenAI-compatible), category reconciliation, playlist building with ownership tagging, home screen rows via Collection Sections, a weekly scheduled task, and a full configuration page with a manual run button. Not yet exercised against a live server - please report issues.
